title: The Space Station Is Wider Than a Football Field
description: The International Space Station spans 356 feet across and weighs over 900,000 pounds, but its pressurized living area equals just a single airliner.

beats.text: The space station is wider than a football field.
beats.visual: Exterior view of the International Space Station against Earth, 2011

beats.text: It weighs over 900,000 pounds across 356 feet of solar arrays.
beats.visual: Photographs of the solar array wings of the International Space Station, 2007

beats.text: More than 40 delivery flights assembled this giant 250 miles above Earth.
beats.visual: Space Shuttle Endeavour docked to the International Space Station payload bay, 2011
queries: Space Shuttle payload bay ISS assembly

beats.text: Yet inside, its entire pressurized living space equals just one Boeing 747.
beats.visual: Astronaut inside the pressurized interior volume of the ISS Cupola, 2010

beats.text: Seven astronauts orbit the planet inside it at five miles per second.
beats.visual: ISS Expedition crew members working inside the laboratory module, 2021

beats.text: That speed carries them around the entire globe every 90 minutes.
beats.visual: Timelapse photo of Earth atmosphere and city lights from the ISS, 2015

beats.text: NASA plans to crash this 400-ton titan into the Pacific Ocean around 2030.
beats.visual: Diagram of the International Space Station orbital trajectory over Earth, 2024
queries: NASA ISS deorbit plan Pacific Ocean

beats.text: It is a dramatic end for an outpost wider than a football field.
beats.visual: Full view photograph of the International Space Station in orbit, 2011
queries: International Space Station final shuttle flyaround

better_than_last: Applied a clear scale-ladder structure starting from a football field to a Boeing 747 to land the deorbit twist effectively.
